checks.why: Every blocked crawler removes you from that platform’s answers.

checks.label: Canonical tag
checks.why: Tells machines the definitive URL and prevents duplicate-content ambiguity.

checks.label: html lang attribute
checks.why: Lets AI systems classify your content’s language correctly.

checks.label: Page title
checks.why: Answer engines frequently use the title as your source label.

checks.label: Meta description
checks.why: The machine-readable summary of your page.

checks.label: Open Graph tags
checks.why: Keeps previews and shared representations consistent.

checks.label: Structured data (JSON-LD)
checks.why: Explicitly labels your content for machines.

checks.label: Single H1 heading
checks.advice: Use exactly one H1 on the page
checks.why: Makes the page’s main topic unambiguous.

checks.label: Subheading structure (H2)
checks.why: Sectioned content is far easier for AI systems to quote.

checks.label: Organization / WebSite schema
checks.why: Defines your brand as a verifiable entity — the base layer of trust.

checks.label: Content schema (Article, FAQ…)
checks.why: Declares content type and raises citation likelihood.

checks.label: Author / about signals
checks.advice: Add an about page and author information
checks.why: AI systems weigh source credibility through ownership signals.

checks.label: Contact signals
checks.advice: Add a contact page or email link
checks.why: Reachability is a baseline trust marker.
